_about: Patterns that must never appear in AI-rewritten explanation text. A crude safety net, not a guarantee: outputs are also reviewed by hand. 'en' entries are case-insensitive regexes matched on word boundaries; 'hi' entries are plain substrings (word boundaries do not work for Devanagari).
en: you (have|had|may have|might have|probably have|likely have|are suffering)
